facts.business: Sayaji Hotels (Indore) Limited operates the Sayaji Hotel in Indore, a luxury hospitality property offering rooms, food and beverage, banqueting, and event services, and is developing a new brand 'Altara' on the Indore Bypass.

capacity_or_capex.item: Altara hotel project on Indore Bypass

guidance_or_targets.statement: Indian hotel industry expected to achieve double-digit revenue growth of 11-12% in FY 2025-26, moderating to 13-14% in FY 2026-27
Global hospitality market projected to grow at CAGR of 6.1% reaching USD 7.23 trillion by 2029
Global RevPAR projected to grow by 2-3% in 2026

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on leasehold land litigation with Indore Development Authority (IDA) and pending mutation/stamp duty due to ongoing lease cancellation dispute and High Court proceedings; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Leasehold land litigation with Indore Development Authority (IDA) - lease cancelled in 2017, High Court appeal pending, eviction proceedings stayed
Pending mutation of property records and unadjudicated stamp duty liability due to ongoing litigation

Rising costs of capital prompting shift to asset-light models
